facts.title: mewo — animated components for React
facts.description: An open-source shadcn registry of animated React components and sections, powered by Motion and GSAP.

research.name: mewo
research.note: Small shadcn registry of 19 animated React components and sections built with Motion or GSAP, plus a background studio.
unverified: The components' source is public in the GitHub repository xmustafa5/mewo-ui, linked from the site; that repository has not yet been researched in place of this site.
The signature effects were seen only as names on the homepage list; the components page returned 404 and I did not watch them running.
